sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Turns off the MGM+ AI chat assistant, its prompts, and the AI-picks rows.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Removes the Google and Apple sign-in buttons and the Google sign-in sheet at startup.
Gives every title an empty ad plan, so no ad break is scheduled.
Opens the app after the MGM+ logo, without the lion intro video.
Skips the MGM+ promo that plays before a title.
